findings.comment: First sentence is a clear, standalone summary. Third-person declarative, no self-reference. @tparam lowercase with no trailing period.

Description does not begin with 'Returns', so keeping @return is correct. @return adds the Some/None distinction not stated in the first sentence. Backticks on `null`, `Some`, `None`, `jref` all correct. Tags lowercase, no trailing periods.
Single sentence starting with 'Returns'; @return correctly dropped. None case is covered inline. Backtick on `None` correct.
